 Hon'Ble Raj Beer Singh, J. 
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The present application under Section 528 of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (hereinafter referred as 'BNSS') has been filed for quashing of the entire proceedings, including charge-sheet dated 18.03.2024 as well as cognizance order dated 22.03.2024, of Case No. 1432 of 2024 (State Vs.
Piyush Raj), arising out of Case Crime No. 144 of 2022, under Sections - 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B I.P.C., Police Station - Civil Lines, District - Meerut, pending in the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.10, Meerut.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.10, Meerut
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is brother of opposite party no.2 and applicant is a 74 years old person.
The dispute between the parties relates to ancestral property.

It was submitted that the prayer as made above is not being pressed and applicant would appear before the trial court concerned and a direction may be made to the court concerned to decide the bail application of applicant expeditiously in accordance with law laid down in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and Another, 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825 and protection may be granted to the applicant till then.
4. Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and learned A.G.A. have opposed the application.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and Another, 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. In view of the aforesaid, it is directed that in case applicant appears / surrenders before the trial court concerned within a period of three weeks from today and applies for bail, his bail application shall be considered and decided expeditiously in accordance with settled law.

For a period of three weeks from today or till the applicant appears / surrenders before the court concerned, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant in the aforesaid case.
6. The application under Section - 528 BNSS is disposed of in above terms.

(Raj Beer Singh,J.) September 4, 2025 S Rawat  Piush Raj vs State Of U.P. And Another on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/52100344/
